items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: I remember Bunk's band always used to start out at the same tune every night in New York, too... [Interviewer] Is that because you all liked it... [Interviewee] That's about the whole thing about it.

ctx.x: Yeah. I like it. It's a nice idea. I mean, a piece is good, but I like to hear it two or three times. I just wondered, in the old days, they did that all the time then. That was done all the time.

Right on every tune, you know, that you played, if you got the applause, which you did during those days, you got a lot of applause. Excuse me. And then when Bunk went to New York, well, he had that habit, so he just kept it right going.
I know sometimes they play a piece two or sometimes three times. I think as many as four times. Did they do that in the old days, too? They played more than twice sometimes? Oh, yes.
